settings.label: Gift variant position
settings.info: 1 is the gift product's first variant. A sold-out gift hides the block.

settings.label: Minimum quantity
settings.info: With this many of this product in the cart the gift line is added; below it the line is removed.

settings.label: Text
settings.info: Leave blank for "Buy [count] and we add [gift] to your cart". [count] becomes the minimum quantity and [gift] the gift's name. Say "free" only when the discount below exists.

settings.content: The theme only adds the gift line. Create a Buy X Get Y automatic discount (buy this product, get the gift at 100% off) so Shopify prices it at zero; the cart shows "Free" only then.
